command: Split UAVs 1 through 4 into a horizontal line centered at [-5, 13.5, 3] and UAVs 5 through 8 into a horizontal line centered at [5, 13.5, 3], both with 2-meter spacing and 10-second duration. Execute both groups in parallel. After both groups stabilize, merge all eight UAVs into a circle centered at [0, 13.5, 3] with radius 4 meters in 12 seconds using normal motion and safety factor 1.0.
